form.title: Shicilela iphrojekthi
form.imagesPending: Isithombe esisodwa sisathunyelwa: iphrojekthi izohamba lapho sesifikile.
form.discardText: Iphrojekthi oyibhalayo nezithombe zayo kuzosuka kule divayisi.
form.discardChangesText: Ifomu libuyela kulokho okukhonjiswa yiphrojekthi manje.
form.teamRecruiting_one: Iphrojekthi ifuna abanikeli: indima e-{{count}} ivulekile. Izindima nezicelo kuphathwa endaweni yethimba.
form.teamRecruiting_other: Iphrojekthi ifuna abanikeli: izindima ezingu-{{count}} zivulekile. Izindima nezicelo kuphathwa endaweni yethimba.
form.teamRecruitingEmpty: Iphrojekthi ifuna abanikeli, kodwa ayikabi nayo indima evulekile: zishicilele endaweni yethimba.
form.teamNotRecruiting: Iphrojekthi ayifuni banikeli okwamanje. Ukuqasha nezindima kusethwa endaweni yethimba.

essentials.title: Okubalulekile
essentials.text: Okufundwa kuqala ekhadini lombukiso: igama, umusho okhangayo, ubuchwepheshe.

images.title: Izithombe
images.text: Isithombe sesembozo, bese izithombe-skrini zalokho okusebenza kakade. Yilokho okwenza abantu bachofoze.

story.title: Indaba
story.text: Inkinga iphrojekthi eyixazululayo, ngobani, lapho isifike khona, nokulandelayo.

links.title: Izixhumanisi nelayisensi
links.text: Lapho kufundwa khona ikhodi, lapho ingazanywa khona, nalokho wonke umuntu avunyelwe ukukwenza ngayo.

team.title: Ithimba
team.text: Ufuna abanikeli? Indima ngayinye iba isikhangiso, esibonwa amaphrofayela afanelekile.
team.editText: Izindima ezifunwayo zihlala endaweni yethimba, kanye nezicelo.

fields.name: Igama lephrojekthi
fields.nameHint: Igama lendawo yokugcina ikhodi, noma lelo abasebenzisi bakho abalaziyo. Ikheli lekhasi lisuselwa kulo futhi ngeke lishintshe.
fields.taglinePlaceholder: Amabhasi alandelayo eLagos, ngisho ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi
fields.taglineHint: Umusho owodwa wekhadi lombukiso: lokho iphrojekthi ekwenzayo, nokuthi ngobani.
fields.tagsHint: Izilimi, izinhlaka, izihloko (kufika ku-{{count}}): yilokhu abantu abafanele abathola ngakho iphrojekthi.
fields.descriptionPlaceholder:
Inkinga, isixazululo, lapho iphrojekthi isifike khona…

- Okusebenza kakade
- Okulandelayo
fields.descriptionHint: Izigaba, **umbhalo ogqamile**, `ikhodi` nezinhlu: yilokhu ikhasi lephrojekthi elikubonisa ngakho. {{mod}} + Enter ukuze ushicilele.

github.title: Qala endaweni yakho ye-GitHub
github.text: Igama, isiqubulo, ubuchwepheshe, ilayisensi, umboniso nesingeniso se-README kugcwaliswa ngokuchofoza kanye. Usaphethe konke.
github.label: Ikheli lendawo ye-GitHub
github.hint: Namathisela ikheli: ukungenisa kuqala ngokwako. Izindawo zomphakathi kuphela.
github.invalid: Leli akulona ikheli lendawo ye-GitHub: github.com/i-akhawunti/indawo
github.noProfile: Engeza i-GitHub yakho kuphrofayela yakho ukuze uthole izindawo zakho lapha.
github.archived: Le ndawo igcinwe kungobo yomlando ku-GitHub.

errors.notFound: Indawo ayitholakalanga: hlola ikheli. Indawo eyimfihlo ayikwazi ukungeniswa.
errors.rateLimited: I-GitHub ikhawulela izicelo okwamanje: zama futhi emizuzwini embalwa, noma ugcwalise iphrojekthi ngesandla.
errors.unavailable: I-GitHub ayiphenduli okwamanje: zama futhi kamuva, noma ugcwalise iphrojekthi ngesandla.
errors.network: Akukho ukuxhumana: hlola inethiwekhi yakho, bese uzama futhi.

cover.hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP noma GIF. Uzosilungisa ngefomethi yombukiso (16:10) ngaphambi kokuthumela.

crop.help: Hudula isithombe ngaphansi kohlaka, sondeza ngesondo, ngeminwe emibili noma ngesilayida. Ngekhibhodi: imicibisholo, + no −.
crop.blurry: indawo encane: isithombe singase sibe fiphele esikrinini esikhulu

images.errorType: «{{name}}» akusona isithombe esifundekayo: JPEG, PNG, WebP noma GIF.
images.errorSize: Isithombe sidlula u-{{max}} MB ngisho sesincishisiwe: zama isithombe esilula.
images.errorUpload: Isithombe asikwazanga ukuthunyelwa: hlola ukuxhumana kwakho, bese uzama futhi.

gallery.label: Igalari
gallery.hint: Izithombe-skrini zohlelo lokusebenza, izithombe zasenkundleni. Ngasinye silungiswa ku-16:10; ungasilungisa kabusha.
gallery.full_one: Igalari ithatha isithombe esingu-{{count}} kuphela: ezilandelayo azengezwanga.
gallery.full_other: Igalari ithatha izithombe ezingu-{{count}} kuphela: ezilandelayo azengezwanga.
gallery.handleHint: Alt + umcibisholo wesobunxele noma wesokudla ukuze usihambise

about.MIT: MIT: imfushane futhi ivumelekile. Noma ubani angasebenzisa kabusha ikhodi, ngisho nasemkhiqizweni ovaliwe, uma ebalula umbhali.
about.Apache-2.0: Apache 2.0: ivumelekile, inokuvikelwa kwamalungelo obunikazi. Ukukhetha okuvamile kwezinkampani.
about.BSD-3-Clause: BSD 3: ivumelekile njenge-MIT, futhi ivimbela ukusebenzisa igama lakho ukukhangisa umsebenzi osuselwe kuyo.
about.MPL-2.0: MPL 2.0: amafayela ashintshiwe ahlala evulekile; umkhiqizo osele ungavalwa.
about.GPL-3.0: GPL 3.0: noma iyiphi isofthiwe esuselwe kuyo esabalaliswayo kufanele ihlale ivulekile, ngelayisensi efanayo.
about.AGPL-3.0: AGPL 3.0: njenge-GPL, futhi isevisi ye-inthanethi eyisebenzisayo kufanele ishicilele ikhodi yayo nayo.

license.aboutNone: Ngaphandle kwelayisensi, akekho onelungelo ngokomthetho lokusebenzisa kabusha ikhodi: khetha eyodwa ngaphambi kokwamukela abanikeli.

team.recruitingOn: Iphrojekthi izovela phakathi kwalezo eziqasha. Chaza izindima: amaphrofayela afanelekile azozibona.
team.recruitingOff: Kuvule ukuze wamukele abanikeli futhi ushicilele izindima. Ungakwenza kamuva.
team.descriptionPlaceholder: Isikrini sohambo ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, nge-Jetpack Compose…
team.issueHint: Umsebenzi omncane wendawo ongaqala ngawo: abafakizicelo bazokwazi ukuthi bangena kuphi.

preview.pageNotice: Ukubuka kuqala: ikhasi njengoba izivakashi zizolibona

checklist.title: Ilungele ngo-{{percent}}%
checklist.text: Okwenza iphrojekthi ikhange. Igama nencazelo kuphela okuphoqelekile.
